name: St. Francis River — Gruner Ford Access to Millstream Gardens Conservation Area
gaugeName: St. Francis River near Patterson, MO (USGS 07037500)
blurb: St. Francis River in Missouri: sections between public Missouri Department of Conservation accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Gruner Ford Access: approximate area only. Take-out Syenite Access: exact agency access pin. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).

putInAccess.sourceName: Missouri Department of Conservation — Gruner Ford Access (area page)
putInAccess.note: Public river access is documented by Missouri Department of Conservation — Gruner Ford Access (area page). The coordinate is MDC Conservation Area centroids (Discover Nature atlas) — area centroid; approximate area, not the exact launch. Why not exact: the MDC record is a conservation-area centroid, not a launch feature.
putInAccess.directions: From Farmington, take Route H south 3 miles.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: MDC Discover Nature — Boat Ramp features, OBJECTID 95
takeOutAccess.note: MDC Discover Nature — Boat Ramp features, OBJECTID 95 (Boat ramp (MDC)) is the managing agency's own access feature, 22 m from the USGS NHD High Resolution flowline of the Saint Francis River. Imagery check 2026-10-30: Pin at a parking area, path head or ramp head within roughly 40-60 m of the water with a visible route to the bank. Public access: Missouri Department of Conservation — Syenite Access (area page).
